The specification contains 8 user stories (U1-U8) related to Spring Framework, Spring Batch, Spring XD, Hadoop, HDFS, and Cloud Foundry (CF).

Let's break down the user stories and estimate effort for each.

U1: Migrate wiki to project repo. Effort: 8 hours.
U2: Add Hadoop namenode specifics in a config file for DSL sessions. Effort: 12 hours.
U3: Use jdbchdfs batch job as a passthrough without chunk processing. Effort: 16 hours.
U4: Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle in Spring Batch, upgrade XD to Batch release, refactor XD-2486 workaround. Effort: 40 hours.
U5: Create custom job module using Java Config, fix deployment/launching error. Effort: 24 hours.
U6: Continue XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC, design pluggable SPI. Effort: 32 hours.
U7: Update all module docs to include shortDescription. Effort: 16 hours.
U8: Host/read Python script from HDFS, use shell processor in XD on CF. Effort: 24 hours.

Total: 8 + 12 + 16 + 40 + 24 + 32 + 16 + 24 = 172 hours.

technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Implement Java Config for custom job modules to replace XML configurations.
Design a pluggable Service Provider Interface (SPI) for execution environments, with the Receptor API as one implementation option.
Apply execution context decoupling directly in Spring Batch core before upgrading Spring XD to inherit the fix.
Use a shell processor in XD to delegate Python script execution to the Py runtime.
assumptions: The developer has the necessary access rights to the existing wiki and project repository for migration.
The Hadoop cluster and HDFS are accessible and properly configured for development and testing.
The XD-2486 workaround is well-documented and can be safely refactored without breaking existing functionality.
Module documentation is currently in a structured format that allows for the addition of a 'shortDescription' field.
A Cloud Foundry (CF) environment is available for testing the Python script execution via XD.
The jdbchdfs batch job can be modified to support a passthrough mode without chunk processing.

activities.activity_description: Migrate the existing wiki content to the project repository so that it can be tagged with the code and versioned.
Add Hadoop namenode specifics in a config file so that new DSL sessions are automatically configured without pointing to the namenode location every time.
Modify the jdbchdfs batch job to support a passthrough mode without chunk processing to avoid batch read/write overhead.

activities.activity_name: Decouple Execution Context and Upgrade Spring Batch
activities.activity_description: Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle in Spring Batch to avoid CL and serialization errors, upgrade XD to the new Batch release, and refactor the XD-2486 workaround.

activities.activity_name: Fix Custom Job Module Java Config Deployment
activities.activity_description: Enable the creation of custom job modules using Java Config instead of XML, and fix the deployment/launching error where the job is not found.
Continue the XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC by designing a pluggable SPI that is generally applicable, with the Receptor API as one implementation option.
Update all module documentation to include a 'shortDescription' so that users can learn more about the module.

activities.activity_name: Implement HDFS Python Script Execution in XD
activities.activity_description: Enable hosting/reading of Python scripts from HDFS and use the shell processor in XD (on CF) to delegate data science functionality to the Py runtime and receive feedback.
